//: Bildene til fotballkurset. tools/gen-image.py leser denne fila, rendrer kandidater til image-candidates/football/<id>/, og skriver media.json-oppføringa når én blir godtatt med --accept. Prompten som lagde bildet blir stående her, så «hva ba vi om» overlever den som spurte.
//ingen-spillere: INGEN EKTE SPILLERE, INGEN KLUBBMERKER, INGEN ANSIKTER. Ekte fotballfoto er opphavsrettslig beskyttet, og et generert bilde av en gjenkjennelig spiller skal vi ikke lage. Alle bildene her er steder, ting og lys — tomme stadioner, hansker, kritt, en benk i regn. Der en person er med, er det hender eller føtter, aldri et ansikt og aldri en drakt som kan spores til en klubb. Det står i `omits` på hver eneste oppføring, fordi det er nettopp det feltet er til for.
//stil: Dokumentarfoto i tilgjengelig lys, dempet farge, grunn dybdeskarphet. Samme grep som ølkurset: bildene skal se ut som noe noen har vært til stede og tatt, ikke som en illustrasjon.

tom-stadion-natt.prompt: an empty football stadium at night seen from high in the empty stands, floodlights on, the pitch bright green and completely deserted, rows of empty plastic seats in the foreground going out of focus, no people anywhere, hoardings blank and unmarked, no team badges
tom-stadion-natt.style: documentary photograph, available light, muted colour, wide angle, shallow depth of field
tom-stadion-natt.claims: A large football stadium at night with its floodlights on and nobody in it.
tom-stadion-natt.omits: Not a photograph of any particular ground. It carries no club badge, no sponsor and no readable sign, because it stands for the setting and not for a place.

keeperhansker.prompt: a worn pair of goalkeeper gloves lying on wet grass beside a white painted line, close up, the latex scuffed and the stitching frayed, morning light, no hands in them, no brand name visible
keeperhansker.style: documentary photograph, available light, muted colour, shallow depth of field
keeperhansker.claims: A used pair of goalkeeper gloves on grass by a touchline.
keeperhansker.omits: An arrangement made for this picture. No maker's name is shown and no player is implied; the gloves stand for the job, which the chapter argues changed in 1992.

lovbok-lampe.prompt: an open rule book on a dark wooden desk under a single anglepoise lamp, dense columns of small print, a pencil resting in the gutter between the pages, the rest of the room in darkness, no readable words
lovbok-lampe.style: documentary photograph, available light, muted colour, shallow depth of field
lovbok-lampe.claims: An open book of rules under a desk lamp.
lovbok-lampe.omits: The text is not legible and is not the Laws of the Game. It stands for a change written down in 1992, not for a document that exists.

keeperfot-ball.prompt: close up of a black football boot resting on top of a round white and black panelled association football, a soccer ball, perfectly spherical, on the goal line, wet grass, white painted line, the goal net blurred behind, only the lower leg in a long sock visible, no face, no branding
keeperfot-ball.//prompt: Foerste forsoek ga en RUGBYBALL i alle tre kandidatene: brun, oval, sydd. Modellen vet ikke hvilken ball som hoerer til hvilken sport naar prompten bare sier football. Samme feil som oelkurset sitt oel i vinglass, og samme kur: si det tre ganger - rund, hvit og svart, association football.
keeperfot-ball.style: documentary photograph, available light, muted colour, shallow depth of field
keeperfot-ball.claims: A boot resting on a ball on a goal line.
keeperfot-ball.omits: No face and no shirt, so no player is depicted. The boot and the ball are unbranded.

taktikktavle.prompt: a green chalkboard tactics board on an easel in a dim room, a half finished diagram of circles and arrows drawn in white chalk, chalk dust on the tray, no words written, nobody present
taktikktavle.style: documentary photograph, available light, muted colour, shallow depth of field
taktikktavle.claims: A tactics board with an unfinished chalk diagram of circles and arrows.
taktikktavle.omits: The diagram is not a real team's plan and spells nothing. It stands for the act of drawing one.

benk-regn.prompt: an empty dugout beside a football pitch in heavy rain, moulded plastic seats streaked with water, a folded coat left on one of them, the pitch beyond out of focus, nobody sitting there
benk-regn.style: documentary photograph, available light, muted colour, shallow depth of field
benk-regn.claims: An empty dugout beside a pitch, in rain.
benk-regn.omits: Not any particular ground. No badge, no sponsor, and nobody in the seats.

kritt-sidelinje.prompt: a freshly painted white touchline on close cropped grass, photographed low and along the line so it runs away into shallow focus, low evening sun raking across the blades, a few loose grass clippings on the paint
kritt-sidelinje.style: documentary photograph, available light, muted colour, shallow depth of field
kritt-sidelinje.claims: A newly marked touchline on grass in low sun.
kritt-sidelinje.omits: An ordinary line on an ordinary pitch, not a named ground.

analyserom.prompt: a dark video analysis room, three monitors on a desk showing a football pitch filmed from high above, the shapes on the screens too small and blurred to make out, an empty office chair, notes and a coffee cup on the desk, nobody in the room
analyserom.style: documentary photograph, available light, muted colour, shallow depth of field
analyserom.claims: An empty video analysis room with overhead footage of a pitch on the monitors.
analyserom.omits: The footage is indistinct on purpose and shows no identifiable match, team or player.

tomt-mal-natt.prompt: an empty goal at night photographed from behind the net, the mesh sharp and lit by floodlights, the pitch beyond dark and empty, the six yard box faintly visible, nobody in frame
tomt-mal-natt.style: documentary photograph, available light, muted colour, shallow depth of field
tomt-mal-natt.claims: An empty goal seen through the net, under floodlights.
tomt-mal-natt.omits: Not a photograph of a particular ground or moment.
